base_prompt: Write to the organizer of a neighborhood cleanup explaining that you can help with sorting supplies but cannot stay for the whole event. Aim for about 120 words.
text: Hi, thank you for organizing the neighborhood cleanup. I’d be happy to help sort supplies before the event gets underway, including separating gloves by size, organizing trash bags, and setting out litter pickers for volunteers. Unfortunately, I have another commitment later that day, so I won’t be able to stay for the whole event. I can come early and spend about an hour helping make sure everything is ready before I need to leave. Please let me know what time would be most useful for me to arrive and whether there’s anything you’d like me to bring. I’m glad to contribute, even for a short time, and I appreciate all the effort you’re putting into making our neighborhood cleaner.
